items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Remember the Preview? On Ken Allen and Wright.

ctx.x: Yeah, with Bow Boy? No, Bow Boy, he owns a club. Oh. My Sarah, that owns a building, generally, Wright still owns a building, adopted Bow Boy when he was a kid, see? But he's a good lawyer, he was a big lawyer at one time. Yeah. Well, anyhow, after that, I went out of town, I went to Gulfport, Pensacola. I played, you know, a small band because you couldn't get musicians. Mm-hmm.
Yeah, well I was over in Gulfport. Oh yeah? World War II, end of World War II, right after it was over.
